density_after_20ps.qualification: 20 ps is an audit cut-off, not an author-confirmed equilibration time; points are digitizer coordinates.

specific_volume_reconstruction.qualification: Reconstruction from digitized coordinates; does not establish the original MD Tg.

reaction_asphaltene_phenol.qualification: Approximate reconstruction from digitized absolute-energy points, not primary quantum-chemistry output.

reaction_chain_extender.qualification: Approximate reconstruction from digitized absolute-energy points, not primary quantum-chemistry output.

reaction_asphaltene_pyrrole.qualification: Approximate reconstruction from digitized absolute-energy points, not primary quantum-chemistry output.

loss_complex_interpolation.method: Log-frequency/log-modulus interpolation of complex modulus onto loss-modulus digitizer x coordinates, restricted to common range; 1.15 is a screening threshold, not statistical significance.
